title: 跟王爷爷学钓鱼
en: Showing Grandpa Wang your first fish
target: saying what you caught with a measure word (一条鱼)
curriculumStatus: Beginner prototype; HSK level mapping and native-speaker review pending

nodes.pinyin: Diàodào le ma? Gěi wǒ kànkan.
nodes.en: Did you catch one? Let me see.
nodes.speaker: wang

prompt.pinyin: Shuō nǐ diàodào le yì tiáo yú.

nodes.zh: 不错！这是一条鲤鱼。今天晚上可以做红烧鱼。
nodes.pinyin: Búcuò! Zhè shì yì tiáo lǐyú. Jīntiān wǎnshang kěyǐ zuò hóngshāo yú.
nodes.en: Not bad! That's a carp. You could make braised fish tonight.
nodes.speaker: wang
